question: Who among the following was awarded the ‘Best Film Critic’ for his work in Hindi language as part of the National Film Awards 2022 in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepak Dua**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Deepak Dua was awarded the 'Best Film Critic' for his work in Hindi language as part of the National Film Awards 2022.
 
• The National Film Awards are among the most prestigious film awards in India, recognizing excellence in cinematic achievements.
 
• Deepak Dua has been a prominent film critic known for his insightful reviews and contributions to Hindi cinema.
 
• The National Film Awards are presented annually by the Directorate of Film Festivals, an organization set up by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, India.
 
• The awards aim to encourage the production of films of aesthetic and technical excellence and social relevance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Film Awards**

 
 
• The National Film Awards were established in 1954 and are administered by the Directorate of Film Festivals, which is a part of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, India.
 
• The awards aim to recognize the best of Indian cinema and promote the Indian film industry.
 
• The awards are categorized into feature films, non-feature films, and best writing on cinema.
 
• The President of India typically presents the awards at a ceremony held in New Delhi.
 
• Winners are selected by a national panel of judges, which includes eminent personalities from the film industry.
 
 
 
• **Categories of National Film Awards**
 
 
• Feature Film Awards include awards for best director, best actor, best actress, best film, and various technical awards.
 
• Non-Feature Film Awards include categories like best documentary, best short fiction, best animation, etc.
 
• The awards for Best Writing on Cinema recognize books, articles, and reviews on film.
 
 
 
• **Significance of National Film Awards**
 
 
• The awards promote and inspire the Indian film industry to maintain high standards of artistic, technical, and production excellence.
 
• They provide recognition and encouragement to filmmakers, artists, and technicians.
 
• The awards also aim to encourage the study and appreciation of cinema as a medium of art and culture.
